name: Märklin K-Track
description: Märklin's H0 3-rail sectional track without integrated roadbed (the 'K' is from German 'Klein-Schotterbett' — though more commonly understood as the realistic, fine-tie sectional system). Standard Märklin stud-contact 3-rail AC. Named radii in K-Track: R1 = 360 mm, R2 = 424.6 mm, R3 = 515 mm (matches C-Track R3), R4 = 580 mm (≈ C-Track R4 579.3 mm). Standard arc fractions: 30° and 22.5° on R1; 30°, 22.5°, 12.1° on R2; 30°/12.1° on R3+. Article numbers are four-digit Märklin SKUs in the 22xx and 23xx series. K-Track is current production (alongside C-Track) and is preferred when modelers want flex-track-style realism with hand-laid ballasting. K-Track is NOT mechanically interchangeable with C-Track: K is rail-only with thinner profile, C has integrated plastic roadbed.

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog. See docs/library-notes/marklin-k-track.md for per-system caveats.
